title: stator.config.json
description: Stator CLI options (docs/CONFIG.md). The command line overrides the environment, which overrides this file, which overrides the built-in defaults.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this JSON Schema, for editors. Ignored.

entry.description: Entry file; relative to this file. The positional <entry> overrides it.

out.description: build: output path, relative to this file. -o/--out overrides it.

opt.description: build: clang -O level (default 2). --opt and STATOR_OPT override it.

link.description: build: extra clang link flags; each entry splits on spaces like one --link value. Command-line --link flags are appended after these.

emit.description: build: "c" stops after writing C to out (--emit=c); "lib" writes out as a static library lib<name>.a plus lib<name>.pc, and needs emitHeader (--emit=lib). Default "binary".

keepC.description: build: keep the intermediate .c next to the binary.

emitHeader.description: build: write a C header for the unit exports; relative to this file.

unitName.description: build: prefix for stator_<unit>_<name>; letters, digits and _ only (else STA0004).

bundler.description: js mode: "vite" (default; the vite-stator package), "none", or an adapter module — a path relative to this file when it starts with ".", else a package name (docs/BUNDLER.md).

cc.description: build: the C compiler, a name on PATH or a path (relative to this file when it starts with "."); clang, Apple clang or gcc. --cc and CC override it (docs/TOOLCHAIN.md, C compiler). Default: the clang mise pins (clang on Windows).

node.description: build and explain: the Node platform (--node). node:* and bare built-ins resolve to packages/node (docs/MODES.md §6). Default false.
